questions.question: What warning does Proverbs 14 give about a way that seems right?
options: It is the path of the wise
Its end is the way to death
questions.answer: Its end is the way to death

questions.question: What does Proverbs 14 say righteousness does for a nation?
options: Exalts it, while sin is a reproach
Enriches only its kings and nobles
questions.answer: Exalts it, while sin is a reproach

questions.question: Proverbs 14 says even in laughter the heart may ache, and the end of joy may be grief.
There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to _____.
Righteousness exalts a _____, but sin is a reproach to any people.
